label: AUDUSD cross-asset US opening-range continuation into the close (September filter) true 5R
researchSummary: Cross-asset validation of `NG US opening-range continuation into the close (September filter)`. US opening continuation into the closing half-hour. Filter: month 9. True bracket exit uses 2:1 reward/risk; forward PF was recomputed from actual stop/target/time exits. Cross-asset rerun uses true bracket target/stop at 5:1 planned reward-to-risk.
selectionMethod: Fast cross-asset true-RR validation: existing bracket pattern was evaluated on a different asset with pre-2022 train diagnostics, post-2022 strict anti-cheat forward validation, bootstrap checks, and same-asset trade-overlap rejection.
verificationSummary: Cross-asset strict PF 2.34 over 54 trades; average planned RR 4.97, min planned RR 4.39; bootstrap p05 1.11, block-bootstrap p05 1.27, annual pass rate 100%.
